limitations: Vertex-group bounds include occluded geometry. They are not visible segmentation masks.
Painted hair and boots have their own envelopes; compare movement relative to one fixed calibration, not raw silhouette sizes.
Head reuse candidates only bound the weighted source head mesh; costume-neck seams and the illustrated hair envelope still need review.
Foot reuse candidates exclude the calf, trouser cuff and painted boot envelope. They do not authorize replacing an entire boot or lower body.

Rigid head candidates translate/rotate one separate head layer from source geometry only, without scaling or reflection. They do not authorize moving a complete painted body, nor certify neck seams or hair-depth occlusion.
No painted pixels were changed and no visual approval is granted.
